title: Vesper and the Sigil
author: K. M. Quintana
blurb: Gideon Okafor, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
